summary: A leading-edge logic fab on Intel's Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona, announced in March 2021 as one of two new fabs worth about $20 billion and named at the September 2021 groundbreaking. Brookfield agreed in 2022 to fund 49% of the two fabs. The original goal was full operation in 2024. Intel said in October 2025 that Fab 52, its fifth high-volume fab at Ocotillo, was fully operational and making Intel 18A products, with high-volume output targeted for later that year.
